Hiligaynon: Chakto gid ini nga plano para sa aton safety sa balay.
English: This plan is exactly right for our safety at home.

Hiligaynon: Hoy! Ikaw gid na ina!
English: Hey! That's really you!

Hiligaynon: Kamusta ka na man?
English: How have you been?

Hiligaynon: Dugay nata wala nag kitaay, no!
English: It's been so long since we last saw each other, right!

Hiligaynon: Maayo man, salamat gid.
English: I'm doing well, thank you so much.

Hiligaynon: Kamusta na ang pamilya mo?
English: How is your family?

Hiligaynon: Maayo man sila, nami man ila updanay.
English: They're fine, they get along well with each other.

Hiligaynon: Ang mga bata mo, dako na sila!
English: Your children, they're big now!

Hiligaynon: Huo, dasig lang pagdako nila.
English: Yes, they grew up so fast.

Hiligaynon: Pila na bata mo?
English: How many children do you have?

Hiligaynon: Tatlo na bata namon subong, kag may bag-o kami liwat.
English: We have three children now, and we have a new one again.

Hiligaynon: Ay, may bag-o pa gali! Lalaki ukung babayi?
English: Oh, you have a new one too! Boy or girl?

Hiligaynon: Babayi. Palangga gid namon sia.
English: A girl. We really love her so much.

Hiligaynon: Ang asawa mo, kumusta na man sia?
English: How is your husband doing?

Hiligaynon: Maayo man sia, gapahuway lang.
English: He's fine, just resting.

Hiligaynon: Dugay na kamo ging kasal no?
English: You've been married for a long time, right?

Hiligaynon: Huo, dose tuig na kami.
English: Yes, it's been twelve years already.

Hiligaynon: Ang imo man bana, kumusta?
English: How about your own husband?

Hiligaynon: Maayo man, nagaobra pa sia sa Iloilo.
English: He's fine, he's still working in Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Diin kamo nagaistar subong?
English: Where do you live now?

Hiligaynon: Sa Jaro giyapon, wala kami nag saylo.
English: Still in Jaro, we didn't move.

Hiligaynon: Na anad na kamo didto?
English: Are you already used to it there?

Hiligaynon: Huo, daw balay na gid namon ina nga lugar.
English: Yes, it really feels like home to us already.

Hiligaynon: Nadumduman mo pa ang dati ta nga mga adlaw?
English: Do you still remember our old days?

Hiligaynon: Huo gid! Nadumduman ko pa gid ato!
English: Yes of course! I still remember that!

Hiligaynon: Pirmi pa ta gakitaay noon, no!
English: We used to always see each other before, right!

Hiligaynon: Dasig lang sang oras.
English: Time passed so quickly.

Hiligaynon: Gusto ko gid nga mag kitaay ta pirme.
English: I really wish we could see each other often.

Hiligaynon: Huo, dapat mag kitaay ta kis-a.
English: Yes, we should really see each other sometime.

Hiligaynon: Sige, lagaw to kis-a.
English: Okay, let's go out sometime.

Hiligaynon: Huo, hindi ta mag bayaay liwat.
English: Yes, let's not drift apart from each other again.

Hiligaynon: Bag-o lang ako nakabalik diri sa Iloilo.
English: I just recently came back here to Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Ay, bag-o ka pa lang? Dugay ka na didto?
English: Oh, you just came back? Were you there long?

Hiligaynon: Duha ka tuig ako nakatiner sa Manila.
English: I stayed in Manila for two years.

Hiligaynon: Grabe ba, dugay na gid gali. Nami man tuya?
English: Wow, that's really a long time. Was it nice there?

Hiligaynon: Nami man, pero mas namiam ko diri sa Iloilo.
English: It was nice, but I enjoyed it more here in Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Huo, wala gid sang maka perdi sa Iloilo.
English: Yes, nothing can really beat Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Miss ko gid ang pagkaon diri, labi na ang KBL.
English: I really missed the food here, especially KBL.

Hiligaynon: Ay huo! Namit gid ang KBL diri!
English: Oh yes! KBL here is really delicious!

Hiligaynon: Kaon ta sang KBL sa sunod adlaw!
English: Let's eat KBL together next time!

Hiligaynon: Huo gid! Sige, ikaw ang mag-imbitar!
English: Yes for sure! Okay, you do the inviting!

Hiligaynon: Nami ang buhok mo subong, nagpa-rebond ka?
English: Your hair looks nice now, did you get it rebonded?

Hiligaynon: Huo, bag-o lang. Gusto mo man?
English: Yes, just recently. Do you want one too?

Hiligaynon: Siguro, medyo daan na gid ang akon.
English: Maybe, mine is already a bit old.

Hiligaynon: Daw bataon man gyapon imo chura, ano ang secret mo?
English: You still look young, what's your secret?

Hiligaynon: Wala lang, matulog lang sang maayo.
English: Nothing really, just sleep well.

Hiligaynon: Ako man, kulang gid sang tulog pirme.
English: Me too, I'm always lacking sleep.

Hiligaynon: Ang mga bata gid ang nagakapoy sa aton.
English: It's really the kids that tire us out.

Hiligaynon: Huo gid, pero palangga ta man gid sila.
English: Yes really, but we still love them so much.

Hiligaynon: Indi mabayran ang pagka-iloy.
English: Motherhood is truly priceless.

Hiligaynon: Huo, budlay pero sadya man.
English: Yes, it's hard but it's also joyful.

Hiligaynon: Tagbalay! May tawo diri sa inyo subong?
English: Anybody home? Is there anyone here right now?

Hiligaynon: Maayong hapon! O, ikaw gali, sulod kamo anay.
English: Good afternoon! Oh, it's you, come in first.

Hiligaynon: Puwede makasulod? Daw may bisita kamo nga iban subong.
English: May I come in? It seems you have other guests right now.

Hiligaynon: Pungko ka lang dira sa sofa, makuha ko anay sang malamig nga tubig.
English: Just sit there on the sofa, I'll get some cold water first.

Hiligaynon: Palihog kuha sang Ice sa fridge para sa juice sang aton bisita.
English: Please get ice from the fridge for our guest's juice.

Hiligaynon: Kanami sang imo bayo, sa diin kamo ma-lagaw subong?
English: Your dress is nice, where are you strolling right now?

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga kahuya, daw indi 'ta man kilalahay.
English: That's enough being shy, it's like we don't know each other.

Hiligaynon: Puerte gid init sa gwa, paki-punas anay sang imo balhas.
English: It's really hot outside, please wipe your sweat first.

Hiligaynon: Maayo gid kay nag-hapit ka diri bago ka mahalin pa-Manila.
English: It's very good that you dropped by here before you leave for Manila.

Hiligaynon: Kamusta na kamo? Nadumduman ko pa gid ang aton istoryahanay kagina.
English: How are you? I still remember our conversation earlier.

Hiligaynon: Sabat kamo dayon kung tawgon kamo ni Tito nyo pakadto diri.
English: Answer immediately if your uncle calls you to come here.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid nga nag-kadto ka, may gin-luto ko nga pansit para sa imo.
English: It's exactly right that you came, I cooked pansit for you.

Hiligaynon: Nagalingin ang ulo ko sa gahod sang mga kuring sa gwa, pasensia na gid.
English: My head is spinning from the noise of the cats outside, I'm really sorry.

Hiligaynon: I-butang lang ang imo bag dira sa sulod sang kwarto.
English: Just put your bag there inside the room.

Hiligaynon: Dugay 'ta na nga wala nag-kitaay, dako na gid gin-bag-o mo.
English: We haven't seen each other for a long time, you've changed a lot.

Hiligaynon: Inom kamo anay kape samtang ga-hulat kay Nanay mo.
English: Drink coffee first while waiting for your Mother.

Hiligaynon: Kaon 'ta! Wala kami sang damo nga sud-an pero manamit 'ni.
English: Let's eat! We don't have a lot of viand but this is delicious.

Hiligaynon: Ugtas gid ko sa trapik, maayo lang kay naka-abot kamo diri sang maayo.
English: I'm really frustrated with the traffic, it's a good thing you safely reached here.

Hiligaynon: Kung makita mo si Toto, hambali sia nga mapa-puli na subong.
English: If you see Toto, tell him to come home right now.

Hiligaynon: Ano bala gusto mo nga snacks? May tinapay kami diri nga bag-o bakal.
English: What snacks do you want? We have freshly bought bread here.

Hiligaynon: Wala pa gid naka-puli si Tatay, basi gab-i na sia maka-abot.
English: Father hasn't come home yet, he might arrive late tonight.

Hiligaynon: May gin-dala ako nga gamay nga pasalubong para sa inyo.
English: I brought a small gift for you.

Hiligaynon: Nami kay nag-bisita kamo, kasadya gid sining adlaw sa inyo pag-abot.
English: It's nice that you visited, today is very joyful with your arrival.

Hiligaynon: Palihog sirado sang pwertahan kung mahalin kamo pa-gwa.
English: Please close the door if you leave to go outside.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga sige tindog dira sa kilid, palapit kamo diri.
English: That's enough standing there on the side, come closer here.

Hiligaynon: Diin ka naghalin ngaa pwerte sa imo ga-panimalhas subong?
English: Where did you come from, why are you so sweaty right now?

Hiligaynon: Chakto bala ang akon direksyon nga gin-hatag sa inyo kagina?
English: Was the direction I gave you earlier correct?

Hiligaynon: Guba ang amon electric fan gani medyo mainit diri sa sulod subong.
English: Our electric fan is broken so it's a bit hot inside here right now.

Hiligaynon: Gusto mo mag-lagaw karun sa hapon pakadto sa plaza agud mag-pahangin?
English: Do you want to stroll this afternoon going to the plaza to get some air?

Hiligaynon: Sabat dayon sa text mo kung naka-puli ka na sang maayo bwas.
English: Answer immediately to your text if you got home safely tomorrow.

Hiligaynon: Manamit gid ining dala mo nga cake, paborito ko 'ni kag sang mga bata.
English: This cake you brought is really delicious, this is mine and the kids' favorite.

Hiligaynon: Nagalingin ang ulo ko sa gahod sang nagalabay nga mga motor sa dalan.
English: My head is spinning from the noise of the passang motorcycles on the street.

Hiligaynon: Ma-study pa gid amon kamanghuran subong sa library para sa iya test.
English: Our youngest will still study right now at the library for his test.

Hiligaynon: Kuha ka lang da sang pagkaon mo, daw balay mo man 'ni.
English: Just get your food there, treat this like your own home.

Hiligaynon: Ligo ka anay didto sa CR para mag-presko ang imo pamatyag.
English: Take a bath first there in the CR so you'll feel refreshed.

Hiligaynon: I-lock ang gate kung gab-i na para safe kita diri sa sulod.
English: Lock the gate when it's late so we are safe inside here.

Hiligaynon: Kinahanglan ko sang inyo bulig subong para mag-preparar sang panyapon.
English: I need your help right now to prepare dinner.

Hiligaynon: Pila kamo bilog nga ma-tulog diri sa amon bwas sa gab-i?
English: How many of you will sleep here at our place tomorrow night?

Hiligaynon: Palihog timpla sang juice kag butangi sang madamo nga Ice.
English: Please mix the juice and put a lot of ice.

Hiligaynon: San-o kamo mabalik diri liwat para mag-bisita sa amon pamilya?
English: When will you come back here again to visit our family?

Hiligaynon: Kung may kinahanglan ka, hambal lang sa akon dayon.
English: If you need anything, just tell me immediately.

Hiligaynon: Gindala ko gid ining mga prutas halin sa tiendahan para sa imo.
English: I really brought these fruits from the market for you.

Hiligaynon: Ubuson ta 'ni nga pagkaon subong, kanugon man kung masira.
English: Let's finish this food right now, it's a waste if it spoils.

Hiligaynon: Pasensia gid kay magamo diri sa amon balay subong, damo ubra.
English: I'm really sorry because it's messy here in our house right now, lots of work.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid ang imo desisyon nga mag-bakasyon diri sa Iloilo subong nga bulan.
English: Your decision to vacation here in Iloilo this month is exactly correct.

Hiligaynon: Halong kamo pirme kung mag-biyahe kamo pabalik sa inyo lugar.
English: Always take care when you travel back to your place.

Hiligaynon: Limpyuhan ko anay ining isa ka kwarto para may tulugan kamo.
English: I will clean this one room first so you have a place to sleep.

Hiligaynon: Daw ma-ulan gani indi na lang 'ta mag-lagaw karun sa gab-i.
English: It looks like it will rain so let's just not stroll tonight.

Hiligaynon: Puerte gid ang amon ugtas sa init kagina sang udto.
English: We were really frustrated by the heat earlier at noon.

Hiligaynon: Sige, babye! Balik kamo liwat diri kung may free time kamo.
English: Okay, goodbye! Come back here again if you have free time.

Hiligaynon: Palihog, pungko kamo anay dira sa sofa samtang ga-preparar ko.
English: Please, be seated there on the sofa while I prepare.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo subong nga nag-bisita kamo diri?
English: What can I do for you right now that you visited here?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang cold juice para ma-preskuhan kamo.
English: Have a drink of cold juice first so you'll be refreshed.

Hiligaynon: Pasensia na gid pero malakat na ako pakadto sa banwa.
English: I'm really sorry but I'm leaving now to go to town.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay dira, paki-butang lang ang imo bag sa kilid.
English: Please be seated there, just put your bag on the side.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa imo bago ko mahalin sa balay?
English: Is there anything I can do for you before I leave the house?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo kape samtang naga-istoryahanay kita diri.
English: Have a drink of coffee first while we are chatting here.

Hiligaynon: Sige, malakat na ako kay ma-lagaw pa ko sa Festive Walk subong.
English: Okay, I'm leaving now because I'm still going for a stroll at Festive Walk right now.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid nga nag-abot ka, pungko anay diri sa tupad ko.
English: It's exactly right that you arrived, please sit here beside me.

Hiligaynon: Palihog dugang sang Ice sa baso kung gusto mo mag-inom anay.
English: Please add some ice to the glass if you want to drink first.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga kahuya, ano ang mahimo ko para mag-enjoy ka diri?
English: That's enough being shy, what can I do so you'll enjoy it here?

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako subong kay nagatawag na si Nanay sa akon.
English: I'm leaving right now because Mother is already calling me.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay kamo, kuhaon ko lang sa sulod sang kwarto ang akon ihatag sa inyo.
English: Please be seated, I'll just get what I'm giving you inside the room.

Hiligaynon: Puerte imo balhas, inom anay kamo sang tubig nga madamo sang Ice.
English: You are sweating so much, have a drink of water with lots of ice first.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa inyo project bago ako mahalin?
English: Is there anything I can do for your project before I leave?

Hiligaynon: Sige lang, pungko anay diri kay mapahuway 'ta kadali.
English: It's okay, please sit here for a while because we will rest a bit.

Hiligaynon: Nagalingin ang ulo ko sa kadasig sang oras, malakat na ako gali!
English: My head is spinning from how fast time goes, I'm leaving now indeed!

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang beer bago kita mag-lagaw sa gwa karun.
English: Have a drink of beer first before we stroll outside later.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo subong para madasig matapos ang inyo ubra?
English: What can I do for you right now so your work will finish quickly?

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako bago mag-ulan kay wala ko payong nga dala.
English: I'm leaving now before it rains because I didn't bring an umbrella.

Hiligaynon: Pungko kamo anay dira sa terrace para maka-pahangin kamo sang maayo.
English: Please sit there on the terrace first so you can get some good air.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid ini nga oras para mag-inom anay kamo sang mainit nga tsokolate.
English: This is exactly the right time for you to drink hot chocolate first.

Hiligaynon: Sabat kamo dayon kung may lakat kamo kay malakat na ako subong.
English: Answer immediately if you have an errand because I am leaving right now.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga pahuway, ano ang mahimo ko para maka-umpisa na 'ta?
English: That's enough resting, what can I do so we can start already?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang tubig kay daw puerte gid inyo ubo.
English: Have a drink of water first because your cough seems really bad.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay diri, indi ka mag-tindog dira sa idalom sang init para indi ka mag-balhas.
English: Please sit here, don't stand there under the heat so you won't sweat.

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako bago mag-trapik sa Diversion Road subong.
English: I'm leaving now before traffic builds up at Diversion Road right now.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa imo bago ka mahalin sa opisina?
English: Is there anything I can do for you before you leave the office?

Hiligaynon: Ugtas gid ko sa gahod sa gwa, pungko anay kita diri sa sulod sang kwarto.
English: I'm really frustrated with the noise outside, let's sit here inside the room first.

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang milk tea nga akon gin-bakal kagina sa mall.
English: Have a drink of the milk tea I bought earlier at the mall.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo para indi na kamo mag-balik diri bwas?
English: What can I do for you so you won't have to come back here tomorrow?

Hiligaynon: Sige, malakat na ako, ikaw na lang ang bahala diri sa balay.
English: Okay, I'm leaving now, I leave the house in your care.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay sa higad kay ma-limpyo ko sining lapta sa salog.
English: Please sit on the side first because I will clean this mess on the floor.

Hiligaynon: Kung gusto mo mag-inom anay, palihog kuha lang sang baso didto.
English: If you want to drink first, please just get a glass over there.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid, malakat na ako kay tapos na ang akon ulobrahon.
English: Exactly right, I'm leaving now because my chores are done.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para madasig ka maka-puli bago mag-gab-i?
English: Is there anything I can do so you can go home quickly before it gets dark?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang softdrinks kag butangi sang Ice para presko.
English: Have a drink of softdrinks first and put ice so it's refreshing.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga reklamo, pungko anay diri kag mag-kalma.
English: That's enough complaining, please sit here and calm down.

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako pa-Jaro Plaza subong para mag-lagaw kaupod ang akon migo.
English: I'm leaving now for Jaro Plaza right now to stroll with my friend.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo, gusto nyo ipa-init ko liwat ang sud-an?
English: What can I do for you, do you want me to reheat the viand?

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay kamo, indi gid ako mag-dugay diri kag malakat na ako.
English: Please be seated, I really won't stay long here and I will leave soon.

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo kay kanamit sining juice, chakto gid ang timpla.
English: Have a drink first because this juice is delicious, the mix is exactly right.

Hiligaynon: Sabat ka lang sa akon message karun kay malakat na ako subong.
English: Just answer my message later because I'm leaving today.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa imo bago ko mag-lock sang kwarto?
English: Is there anything I can do for you before I lock the room?

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay dira kag pahid sang imo balhas samtang naga-hulat.
English: Please sit there and wipe your sweat while waiting.

Hiligaynon: Ugtas na gid ko sa kahulat, gani malakat na ako subong.
English: I'm really frustrated with waiting, so I'm leaving right now.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo para mag-nami ang inyo pamatyag?
English: What can I do for you so you will feel better?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang tubig kung puerte gid kapoy nyo halin sa lagaw.
English: Have a drink of water first if you are really tired from strolling.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay kamo kay may i-istorya ko sa inyo nga importante.
English: Please be seated because I have something important to tell you.

Hiligaynon: Sige, malakat na ako, halong kamo pirme kung mahalin kamo diri.
English: Okay, I'm leaving now, always take care when you leave here.

English: How much is the taxi fare if we have an emergency going to the city?

Hiligaynon: Ma-study kamo mayad sa balay para wala ugtas kung may exam bwas.
English: Study well at home so there's no frustration if there's an exam tomorrow.

Hiligaynon: Dali na, kaon na 'ta samtang mainit pa ang aton sud-an.
English: Come on, let's eat while our viand is still hot.

Hiligaynon: Inom kamo madamo nga tubig para indi init pamatyag nyo sa tunga sang init.
English: Drink plenty of water so you won't feel hot in the middle of the heat.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid ini nga plano para sa aton safety sa balay.
English: This plan is exactly right for our safety at home.

Hiligaynon: Hoy! Ikaw gid na ina!
English: Hey! That's really you!

Hiligaynon: Kamusta ka na man?
English: How have you been?

Hiligaynon: Dugay nata wala nag kitaay, no!
English: It's been so long since we last saw each other, right!

Hiligaynon: Maayo man, salamat gid.
English: I'm doing well, thank you so much.

Hiligaynon: Kamusta na ang pamilya mo?
English: How is your family?

Hiligaynon: Maayo man sila, nami man ila updanay.
English: They're fine, they get along well with each other.

Hiligaynon: Ang mga bata mo, dako na sila!
English: Your children, they're big now!

Hiligaynon: Huo, dasig lang pagdako nila.
English: Yes, they grew up so fast.

Hiligaynon: Pila na bata mo?
English: How many children do you have?

Hiligaynon: Tatlo na bata namon subong, kag may bag-o kami liwat.
English: We have three children now, and we have a new one again.

Hiligaynon: Ay, may bag-o pa gali! Lalaki ukung babayi?
English: Oh, you have a new one too! Boy or girl?

Hiligaynon: Babayi. Palangga gid namon sia.
English: A girl. We really love her so much.

Hiligaynon: Ang asawa mo, kumusta na man sia?
English: How is your husband doing?

Hiligaynon: Maayo man sia, gapahuway lang.
English: He's fine, just resting.

Hiligaynon: Dugay na kamo ging kasal no?
English: You've been married for a long time, right?

Hiligaynon: Huo, dose tuig na kami.
English: Yes, it's been twelve years already.

Hiligaynon: Ang imo man bana, kumusta?
English: How about your own husband?

Hiligaynon: Maayo man, nagaobra pa sia sa Iloilo.
English: He's fine, he's still working in Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Diin kamo nagaistar subong?
English: Where do you live now?

Hiligaynon: Sa Jaro giyapon, wala kami nag saylo.
English: Still in Jaro, we didn't move.

Hiligaynon: Na anad na kamo didto?
English: Are you already used to it there?

Hiligaynon: Huo, daw balay na gid namon ina nga lugar.
English: Yes, it really feels like home to us already.

Hiligaynon: Nadumduman mo pa ang dati ta nga mga adlaw?
English: Do you still remember our old days?

Hiligaynon: Huo gid! Nadumduman ko pa gid ato!
English: Yes of course! I still remember that!

Hiligaynon: Pirmi pa ta gakitaay noon, no!
English: We used to always see each other before, right!

Hiligaynon: Dasig lang sang oras.
English: Time passed so quickly.

Hiligaynon: Gusto ko gid nga mag kitaay ta pirme.
English: I really wish we could see each other often.

Hiligaynon: Huo, dapat mag kitaay ta kis-a.
English: Yes, we should really see each other sometime.

Hiligaynon: Sige, lagaw to kis-a.
English: Okay, let's go out sometime.

Hiligaynon: Huo, hindi ta mag bayaay liwat.
English: Yes, let's not drift apart from each other again.

Hiligaynon: Bag-o lang ako nakabalik diri sa Iloilo.
English: I just recently came back here to Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Ay, bag-o ka pa lang? Dugay ka na didto?
English: Oh, you just came back? Were you there long?

Hiligaynon: Duha ka tuig ako nakatiner sa Manila.
English: I stayed in Manila for two years.

Hiligaynon: Grabe ba, dugay na gid gali. Nami man tuya?
English: Wow, that's really a long time. Was it nice there?

Hiligaynon: Nami man, pero mas namiam ko diri sa Iloilo.
English: It was nice, but I enjoyed it more here in Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Huo, wala gid sang maka perdi sa Iloilo.
English: Yes, nothing can really beat Iloilo.

Hiligaynon: Miss ko gid ang pagkaon diri, labi na ang KBL.
English: I really missed the food here, especially KBL.

Hiligaynon: Ay huo! Namit gid ang KBL diri!
English: Oh yes! KBL here is really delicious!

Hiligaynon: Kaon ta sang KBL sa sunod adlaw!
English: Let's eat KBL together next time!

Hiligaynon: Huo gid! Sige, ikaw ang mag-imbitar!
English: Yes for sure! Okay, you do the inviting!

Hiligaynon: Nami ang buhok mo subong, nagpa-rebond ka?
English: Your hair looks nice now, did you get it rebonded?

Hiligaynon: Huo, bag-o lang. Gusto mo man?
English: Yes, just recently. Do you want one too?

Hiligaynon: Siguro, medyo daan na gid ang akon.
English: Maybe, mine is already a bit old.

Hiligaynon: Daw bataon man gyapon imo chura, ano ang secret mo?
English: You still look young, what's your secret?

Hiligaynon: Wala lang, matulog lang sang maayo.
English: Nothing really, just sleep well.

Hiligaynon: Ako man, kulang gid sang tulog pirme.
English: Me too, I'm always lacking sleep.

Hiligaynon: Ang mga bata gid ang nagakapoy sa aton.
English: It's really the kids that tire us out.

Hiligaynon: Huo gid, pero palangga ta man gid sila.
English: Yes really, but we still love them so much.

Hiligaynon: Indi mabayran ang pagka-iloy.
English: Motherhood is truly priceless.

Hiligaynon: Huo, budlay pero sadya man.
English: Yes, it's hard but it's also joyful.

Hiligaynon: Tagbalay! May tawo diri sa inyo subong?
English: Anybody home? Is there anyone here right now?

Hiligaynon: Maayong hapon! O, ikaw gali, sulod kamo anay.
English: Good afternoon! Oh, it's you, come in first.

Hiligaynon: Puwede makasulod? Daw may bisita kamo nga iban subong.
English: May I come in? It seems you have other guests right now.

Hiligaynon: Pungko ka lang dira sa sofa, makuha ko anay sang malamig nga tubig.
English: Just sit there on the sofa, I'll get some cold water first.

Hiligaynon: Palihog kuha sang Ice sa fridge para sa juice sang aton bisita.
English: Please get ice from the fridge for our guest's juice.

Hiligaynon: Kanami sang imo bayo, sa diin kamo ma-lagaw subong?
English: Your dress is nice, where are you strolling right now?

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga kahuya, daw indi 'ta man kilalahay.
English: That's enough being shy, it's like we don't know each other.

Hiligaynon: Puerte gid init sa gwa, paki-punas anay sang imo balhas.
English: It's really hot outside, please wipe your sweat first.

Hiligaynon: Maayo gid kay nag-hapit ka diri bago ka mahalin pa-Manila.
English: It's very good that you dropped by here before you leave for Manila.

Hiligaynon: Kamusta na kamo? Nadumduman ko pa gid ang aton istoryahanay kagina.
English: How are you? I still remember our conversation earlier.

Hiligaynon: Sabat kamo dayon kung tawgon kamo ni Tito nyo pakadto diri.
English: Answer immediately if your uncle calls you to come here.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid nga nag-kadto ka, may gin-luto ko nga pansit para sa imo.
English: It's exactly right that you came, I cooked pansit for you.

Hiligaynon: Nagalingin ang ulo ko sa gahod sang mga kuring sa gwa, pasensia na gid.
English: My head is spinning from the noise of the cats outside, I'm really sorry.

Hiligaynon: I-butang lang ang imo bag dira sa sulod sang kwarto.
English: Just put your bag there inside the room.

Hiligaynon: Dugay 'ta na nga wala nag-kitaay, dako na gid gin-bag-o mo.
English: We haven't seen each other for a long time, you've changed a lot.

Hiligaynon: Inom kamo anay kape samtang ga-hulat kay Nanay mo.
English: Drink coffee first while waiting for your Mother.

Hiligaynon: Kaon 'ta! Wala kami sang damo nga sud-an pero manamit 'ni.
English: Let's eat! We don't have a lot of viand but this is delicious.

Hiligaynon: Ugtas gid ko sa trapik, maayo lang kay naka-abot kamo diri sang maayo.
English: I'm really frustrated with the traffic, it's a good thing you safely reached here.

Hiligaynon: Kung makita mo si Toto, hambali sia nga mapa-puli na subong.
English: If you see Toto, tell him to come home right now.

Hiligaynon: Ano bala gusto mo nga snacks? May tinapay kami diri nga bag-o bakal.
English: What snacks do you want? We have freshly bought bread here.

Hiligaynon: Wala pa gid naka-puli si Tatay, basi gab-i na sia maka-abot.
English: Father hasn't come home yet, he might arrive late tonight.

Hiligaynon: May gin-dala ako nga gamay nga pasalubong para sa inyo.
English: I brought a small gift for you.

Hiligaynon: Nami kay nag-bisita kamo, kasadya gid sining adlaw sa inyo pag-abot.
English: It's nice that you visited, today is very joyful with your arrival.

Hiligaynon: Palihog sirado sang pwertahan kung mahalin kamo pa-gwa.
English: Please close the door if you leave to go outside.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga sige tindog dira sa kilid, palapit kamo diri.
English: That's enough standing there on the side, come closer here.

Hiligaynon: Diin ka naghalin ngaa pwerte sa imo ga-panimalhas subong?
English: Where did you come from, why are you so sweaty right now?

Hiligaynon: Chakto bala ang akon direksyon nga gin-hatag sa inyo kagina?
English: Was the direction I gave you earlier correct?

Hiligaynon: Guba ang amon electric fan gani medyo mainit diri sa sulod subong.
English: Our electric fan is broken so it's a bit hot inside here right now.

Hiligaynon: Gusto mo mag-lagaw karun sa hapon pakadto sa plaza agud mag-pahangin?
English: Do you want to stroll this afternoon going to the plaza to get some air?

Hiligaynon: Sabat dayon sa text mo kung naka-puli ka na sang maayo bwas.
English: Answer immediately to your text if you got home safely tomorrow.

Hiligaynon: Manamit gid ining dala mo nga cake, paborito ko 'ni kag sang mga bata.
English: This cake you brought is really delicious, this is mine and the kids' favorite.

Hiligaynon: Nagalingin ang ulo ko sa gahod sang nagalabay nga mga motor sa dalan.
English: My head is spinning from the noise of the passang motorcycles on the street.

Hiligaynon: Ma-study pa gid amon kamanghuran subong sa library para sa iya test.
English: Our youngest will still study right now at the library for his test.

Hiligaynon: Kuha ka lang da sang pagkaon mo, daw balay mo man 'ni.
English: Just get your food there, treat this like your own home.

Hiligaynon: Ligo ka anay didto sa CR para mag-presko ang imo pamatyag.
English: Take a bath first there in the CR so you'll feel refreshed.

Hiligaynon: I-lock ang gate kung gab-i na para safe kita diri sa sulod.
English: Lock the gate when it's late so we are safe inside here.

Hiligaynon: Kinahanglan ko sang inyo bulig subong para mag-preparar sang panyapon.
English: I need your help right now to prepare dinner.

Hiligaynon: Pila kamo bilog nga ma-tulog diri sa amon bwas sa gab-i?
English: How many of you will sleep here at our place tomorrow night?

Hiligaynon: Palihog timpla sang juice kag butangi sang madamo nga Ice.
English: Please mix the juice and put a lot of ice.

Hiligaynon: San-o kamo mabalik diri liwat para mag-bisita sa amon pamilya?
English: When will you come back here again to visit our family?

Hiligaynon: Kung may kinahanglan ka, hambal lang sa akon dayon.
English: If you need anything, just tell me immediately.

Hiligaynon: Gindala ko gid ining mga prutas halin sa tiendahan para sa imo.
English: I really brought these fruits from the market for you.

Hiligaynon: Ubuson ta 'ni nga pagkaon subong, kanugon man kung masira.
English: Let's finish this food right now, it's a waste if it spoils.

Hiligaynon: Pasensia gid kay magamo diri sa amon balay subong, damo ubra.
English: I'm really sorry because it's messy here in our house right now, lots of work.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid ang imo desisyon nga mag-bakasyon diri sa Iloilo subong nga bulan.
English: Your decision to vacation here in Iloilo this month is exactly correct.

Hiligaynon: Halong kamo pirme kung mag-biyahe kamo pabalik sa inyo lugar.
English: Always take care when you travel back to your place.

Hiligaynon: Limpyuhan ko anay ining isa ka kwarto para may tulugan kamo.
English: I will clean this one room first so you have a place to sleep.

Hiligaynon: Daw ma-ulan gani indi na lang 'ta mag-lagaw karun sa gab-i.
English: It looks like it will rain so let's just not stroll tonight.

Hiligaynon: Puerte gid ang amon ugtas sa init kagina sang udto.
English: We were really frustrated by the heat earlier at noon.

Hiligaynon: Sige, babye! Balik kamo liwat diri kung may free time kamo.
English: Okay, goodbye! Come back here again if you have free time.

Hiligaynon: Palihog, pungko kamo anay dira sa sofa samtang ga-preparar ko.
English: Please, be seated there on the sofa while I prepare.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo subong nga nag-bisita kamo diri?
English: What can I do for you right now that you visited here?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang cold juice para ma-preskuhan kamo.
English: Have a drink of cold juice first so you'll be refreshed.

Hiligaynon: Pasensia na gid pero malakat na ako pakadto sa banwa.
English: I'm really sorry but I'm leaving now to go to town.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay dira, paki-butang lang ang imo bag sa kilid.
English: Please be seated there, just put your bag on the side.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa imo bago ko mahalin sa balay?
English: Is there anything I can do for you before I leave the house?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo kape samtang naga-istoryahanay kita diri.
English: Have a drink of coffee first while we are chatting here.

Hiligaynon: Sige, malakat na ako kay ma-lagaw pa ko sa Festive Walk subong.
English: Okay, I'm leaving now because I'm still going for a stroll at Festive Walk right now.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid nga nag-abot ka, pungko anay diri sa tupad ko.
English: It's exactly right that you arrived, please sit here beside me.

Hiligaynon: Palihog dugang sang Ice sa baso kung gusto mo mag-inom anay.
English: Please add some ice to the glass if you want to drink first.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga kahuya, ano ang mahimo ko para mag-enjoy ka diri?
English: That's enough being shy, what can I do so you'll enjoy it here?

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako subong kay nagatawag na si Nanay sa akon.
English: I'm leaving right now because Mother is already calling me.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay kamo, kuhaon ko lang sa sulod sang kwarto ang akon ihatag sa inyo.
English: Please be seated, I'll just get what I'm giving you inside the room.

Hiligaynon: Puerte imo balhas, inom anay kamo sang tubig nga madamo sang Ice.
English: You are sweating so much, have a drink of water with lots of ice first.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa inyo project bago ako mahalin?
English: Is there anything I can do for your project before I leave?

Hiligaynon: Sige lang, pungko anay diri kay mapahuway 'ta kadali.
English: It's okay, please sit here for a while because we will rest a bit.

Hiligaynon: Nagalingin ang ulo ko sa kadasig sang oras, malakat na ako gali!
English: My head is spinning from how fast time goes, I'm leaving now indeed!

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang beer bago kita mag-lagaw sa gwa karun.
English: Have a drink of beer first before we stroll outside later.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo subong para madasig matapos ang inyo ubra?
English: What can I do for you right now so your work will finish quickly?

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako bago mag-ulan kay wala ko payong nga dala.
English: I'm leaving now before it rains because I didn't bring an umbrella.

Hiligaynon: Pungko kamo anay dira sa terrace para maka-pahangin kamo sang maayo.
English: Please sit there on the terrace first so you can get some good air.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid ini nga oras para mag-inom anay kamo sang mainit nga tsokolate.
English: This is exactly the right time for you to drink hot chocolate first.

Hiligaynon: Sabat kamo dayon kung may lakat kamo kay malakat na ako subong.
English: Answer immediately if you have an errand because I am leaving right now.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga pahuway, ano ang mahimo ko para maka-umpisa na 'ta?
English: That's enough resting, what can I do so we can start already?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang tubig kay daw puerte gid inyo ubo.
English: Have a drink of water first because your cough seems really bad.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay diri, indi ka mag-tindog dira sa idalom sang init para indi ka mag-balhas.
English: Please sit here, don't stand there under the heat so you won't sweat.

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako bago mag-trapik sa Diversion Road subong.
English: I'm leaving now before traffic builds up at Diversion Road right now.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa imo bago ka mahalin sa opisina?
English: Is there anything I can do for you before you leave the office?

Hiligaynon: Ugtas gid ko sa gahod sa gwa, pungko anay kita diri sa sulod sang kwarto.
English: I'm really frustrated with the noise outside, let's sit here inside the room first.

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang milk tea nga akon gin-bakal kagina sa mall.
English: Have a drink of the milk tea I bought earlier at the mall.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo para indi na kamo mag-balik diri bwas?
English: What can I do for you so you won't have to come back here tomorrow?

Hiligaynon: Sige, malakat na ako, ikaw na lang ang bahala diri sa balay.
English: Okay, I'm leaving now, I leave the house in your care.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay sa higad kay ma-limpyo ko sining lapta sa salog.
English: Please sit on the side first because I will clean this mess on the floor.

Hiligaynon: Kung gusto mo mag-inom anay, palihog kuha lang sang baso didto.
English: If you want to drink first, please just get a glass over there.

Hiligaynon: Chakto gid, malakat na ako kay tapos na ang akon ulobrahon.
English: Exactly right, I'm leaving now because my chores are done.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para madasig ka maka-puli bago mag-gab-i?
English: Is there anything I can do so you can go home quickly before it gets dark?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang softdrinks kag butangi sang Ice para presko.
English: Have a drink of softdrinks first and put ice so it's refreshing.

Hiligaynon: Tama na na nga reklamo, pungko anay diri kag mag-kalma.
English: That's enough complaining, please sit here and calm down.

Hiligaynon: Malakat na ako pa-Jaro Plaza subong para mag-lagaw kaupod ang akon migo.
English: I'm leaving now for Jaro Plaza right now to stroll with my friend.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo, gusto nyo ipa-init ko liwat ang sud-an?
English: What can I do for you, do you want me to reheat the viand?

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay kamo, indi gid ako mag-dugay diri kag malakat na ako.
English: Please be seated, I really won't stay long here and I will leave soon.

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo kay kanamit sining juice, chakto gid ang timpla.
English: Have a drink first because this juice is delicious, the mix is exactly right.

Hiligaynon: Sabat ka lang sa akon message karun kay malakat na ako subong.
English: Just answer my message later because I'm leaving today.

Hiligaynon: May mahimo bala ako para sa imo bago ko mag-lock sang kwarto?
English: Is there anything I can do for you before I lock the room?

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay dira kag pahid sang imo balhas samtang naga-hulat.
English: Please sit there and wipe your sweat while waiting.

Hiligaynon: Ugtas na gid ko sa kahulat, gani malakat na ako subong.
English: I'm really frustrated with waiting, so I'm leaving right now.

Hiligaynon: Ano ang mahimo ko sa inyo para mag-nami ang inyo pamatyag?
English: What can I do for you so you will feel better?

Hiligaynon: Inom anay kamo sang tubig kung puerte gid kapoy nyo halin sa lagaw.
English: Have a drink of water first if you are really tired from strolling.

Hiligaynon: Pungko anay kamo kay may i-istorya ko sa inyo nga importante.
English: Please be seated because I have something important to tell you.

Hiligaynon: Sige, malakat na ako, halong kamo pirme kung mahalin kamo diri.
English: Okay, I'm leaving now, always take care when you leave here.

English: The news of salvation is good.

Hiligaynon: Nagapamuhi ang mga tawo para sa pista.
English: The people are gathering for the fiesta.

Hiligaynon: I-pangamuyo (Ipangamuy-on) naton ang kalinong sang kalibutan.
English: Let us pray for the peace of the world.

Hiligaynon: Ang espiritu sang Dios nagatuytoy sa aton.
English: The spirit of God guides us.

Hiligaynon: Mag-halad kita sang limos sa simbahan.
English: Let us offer alms/donations to the church.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang panabang sa mga santos.
English: We are asking for help/intercession from the saints.

Hiligaynon: Ang parokya naton mabinuligon gid.
English: Our parish is very helpful.

Hiligaynon: I-saulog naton ang Paskua sing malipayon.
English: Let us celebrate Easter/Christmas happily.

Hiligaynon: Nagakanta ang koro sang mga himno.
English: The choir is singing hymns.

Hiligaynon: Ang langit amo ang aton puluy-an sa ulihi.
English: Heaven is our home in the end.

Hiligaynon: Mag-andam sa mga mali-it nga pamatasan.
English: Be careful of sacrilegious/disrespectful behaviors.

Hiligaynon: Nagasulod ang grasya sa mapainubuson nga tawo.
English: Grace enters a humble person.

Hiligaynon: I-pabilin ang paglaum sa imo kasingkasing.
English: Keep hope in your heart.

Hiligaynon: Nagahimo sila sang tuob para sa nasindulan.
English: They are doing fumigation healing for the "greeted" one.

Hiligaynon: Ang babaylan nakahibalo sang karaan nga bulong.
English: The shaman/ritualist knows ancient medicine.

Hiligaynon: Mag-andam sa aswang kon gab-i nga madulom.
English: Be careful of the aswang (ghoul) on a dark night.

Hiligaynon: Ginpahalin sang pari ang malain nga espiritu.
English: The priest expelled the evil spirit.

Hiligaynon: May anting-anting sia sa sulod sang bulsa.
English: He has an amulet/charm inside his pocket.

Hiligaynon: Nagapamati kami sa mga sugilanon sang mga malatiko.
English: We listen to the tales/stories of the elders (lore).

Hiligaynon: I-tabon ang bata basi masindulan.
English: Cover the child so he/she won't be spiritually greeted/hexed.

Hiligaynon: Nagapati ka bala sa kama-kama?
English: Do you believe in small earth dwellers/elves?

Hiligaynon: Ang mari-it nga lugar dapat likawan.
English: Enchanted/Dangerous places should be avoided.

Hiligaynon: Nagabaton kami sang komunyon kada Misa.
English: We receive communion every Mass.

Hiligaynon: I-halong ang imo kalag sa malain nga dalan.
English: Keep your soul away from the bad path.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang bendisyon sa ginikanan.
English: We are asking for a blessing from our parents.

Hiligaynon: Ang altar puno sang mga bulak.
English: The altar is full of flowers.

Hiligaynon: Mag-hinulsol kita sa aton mga sala.
English: Let us repent for our sins.

Hiligaynon: Nagakanta sila sang Pasyon sa Mahal nga Adlaw.
English: They are singing the Passion of Christ during Holy Week.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagsimba nagahatag sang kalinong.
English: Worshipping gives peace.

Hiligaynon: I-pa-misa naton ang aton namatay nga himata.
English: Let’s have a Mass offered for our deceased relative.

Hiligaynon: Nagapanguros kami sa atubangan sang santuaryo.
English: We make the sign of the cross in front of the sanctuary.

Hiligaynon: Ang paghigugma amo ang pinaka-daku nga sugo.
English: Love is the greatest commandment.

Hiligaynon: I-hatag ang ikapulo para sa buluhaton sang Dios.
English: Give the tithe for the work of God.

Hiligaynon: Nagasunod kami sa mga tudlo sang aton Ginuo.
English: We follow the teachings of our Lord.

Hiligaynon: Ang impiyerno malayo sa grasya sang Dios.
English: Hell is far from the grace of God.

Hiligaynon: Mag-puyo kita sa dalan sang kamatuoran.
English: Let us live in the path of truth.

Hiligaynon: Nagapakita ang mago sang kasanag sa gab-i.
English: The supernatural light/wisp shows brightness at night.

Hiligaynon: I-likaw ang balay sa malain nga dimalas.
English: Steer the house away from bad luck/curses.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang kaalam sa Espiritu Santo.
English: We are asking for wisdom from the Holy Spirit.

Hiligaynon: Ang pag-antus may kalipay sa ulihi.
English: Suffering has joy in the end.

Hiligaynon: I-pa-lubong ang patay sa insakto nga paagi.
English: Have the dead buried in the correct way.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang kabaskog sa pagtuo.
English: We are asking for strength in faith.

Hiligaynon: Ang pag-abiabi sa estranyo isa ka grasya.
English: Welcoming a stranger is a grace.

Hiligaynon: Mag-halad kita sang aton kabuhi sa Dios.
English: Let us offer our lives to God.

Hiligaynon: Nagasulod ang kasanag sa sulod sang kasingkasing.
English: Light enters inside the heart.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagpaubos nagapakita sang daku nga pagtoo.
English: Humility shows great faith.

Hiligaynon: I-pangamuyo naton ang mga bilanggo.
English: Let us pray for the prisoners.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang kaluoy sa aton Ginuo.
English: We are asking for mercy from our Lord.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagkamabinuligon tanda sang maayo nga Kristiyano.
English: Helpfulness is a sign of a good Christian.

Hiligaynon: I-pabilin ang kalinong sa aton parokya.
English: Maintain peace in our parish.

Hiligaynon: Nagapamati kami sa ambahanon sang pagdayaw.
English: We are listening to the song of praise.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagsalig sa Dios wala sing katapusan.
English: Trust in God has no end.

Hiligaynon: I-pa-tuob ang balay para malayo ang balatian.
English: Have the house fumigated/ritually cleansed to keep illness away.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangita kami sang kaayuhan sang aton lawas.
English: We are looking for the wellness/healing of our bodies.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagkamatuod nagahilway sa aton.
English: The truth sets us free.

Hiligaynon: Mag-upod kita sa prosesyon sang Santo Niño.
English: Let us join the procession of the Holy Child.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang patuytoy sa adlaw-adlaw.
English: We are asking for guidance every day.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagpasensya isa ka daku nga hiyas.
English: Patience is a great virtue.

Hiligaynon: I-halong ang aton hambal sa isigkatawo.
English: Be careful with our speech toward others.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang grasya para sa pamilya.
English: We are asking for grace for the family.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagpangamuyo nagapabaskog sang kalag.
English: Praying strengthens the soul.

Hiligaynon: I-pa-bendisyon ang aton mga kasangkapan.
English: Have our tools/possessions blessed.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang kalinong sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
English: We are asking for peace in the whole world.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagkamaluluy-on amo ang aton dalan.
English: Compassion/Mercy is our path.

Hiligaynon: I-pabilin ang pagtoo bisan may pag-antus.
English: Keep the faith even when there is suffering.

Hiligaynon: Nagapamati kami sa pulong sang Manluluwas.
English: We are listening to the word of the Savior.

Hiligaynon: Ang pag-unong sa Dios wala sing baylo.
English: Loyalty/Staying with God has no substitute.

Hiligaynon: I-pa-santwar ang aton mga huna-huna.
English: Sanctify/Consecrate our thoughts.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang kabugana sa pag-ani.
English: We are asking for abundance in harvesting.

Hiligaynon: Ang pag-inupdanay sa pagtoo manami gid.
English: Companionship in faith is very good.

Hiligaynon: I-hatag ang pagdayaw sa Ginuo sa tanan nga oras.
English: Give praise to the Lord at all times.

Hiligaynon: Salamat gid sa Dios sa tanan nga grasya.
English: Thank you very much to God for all the grace.

Hiligaynon: Kabay pa nga pakamaayuhon kamo tanan sang Ginuo.
English: May the Lord bless you all.

Hiligaynon: Naga-abot na ang pamanagbanag.
English: Dawn has arrived.

Hiligaynon: Matahum ang bituon sa kaagahon.
English: The star is beautiful in the early morning.

Hiligaynon: Mainit ang silak sang adlaw sining panyaga.
English: The sun's glare is hot this noon/lunchtime.

Hiligaynon: Nagasalum-som na ang hapon.
English: The afternoon is turning into twilight.

Hiligaynon: Mabugnaw ang hangin sining gab-i.
English: The wind is cool this night.

Hiligaynon: Maathag ang bulan sa langit.
English: The moon is clear in the sky.

Hiligaynon: Pila ka oras ang nabilin antes mag-abot ang bus?
English: How many hours are left before the bus arrives?

Hiligaynon: Nagalabay ang minuto sing madasig.
English: The minutes pass by quickly.

Hiligaynon: Sa masunod nga tuig, mabalik ako sa Pavia.
English: Next year, I will return to Pavia.

Hiligaynon: Bwas kita magakitaay sa tienda.
English: Tomorrow we will meet at the market.

Hiligaynon: Kaina pa nag-abot ang ulan.
English: The rain arrived earlier.

Hiligaynon: Subong gid nga tinion, kinahanglan naton maglakat.
English: At this very moment, we need to go.

Hiligaynon: Mabaskog ang amihan sining bulan.
English: The northeast monsoon (cool wind) is strong this month.

Hiligaynon: Nagahulog ang habagat sang madamo nga ulan.
English: The southwest monsoon is dropping a lot of rain.

Hiligaynon: May daku nga kilat sa nakatundan.
English: There is big lightning in the west.

Hiligaynon: Nagadaugdug sing mabaskog sa sidlangan.
English: It is thundering loudly in the east.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangitngit ang langit tungod sa gal-um.
English: The sky is darkening because of the clouds.

Hiligaynon: Sini lang sia nag-abot halin sa syudad.
English: He arrived just recently from the city.

Hiligaynon: Sa masunod nga semana, may pista sa banwa.
English: Next week, there is a fiesta in town.

Hiligaynon: Naga-inulan na sining tig-ululan.
English: It is raining constantly this rainy season.

Hiligaynon: Tama ka init sining tig-ilinit.
English: It is very hot this dry season/summer.

Hiligaynon: Pila ka segundo ang nabilin sa orasan?
English: How many seconds are left on the clock?

Hiligaynon: Anay, maghulat ka sang diutay.
English: Wait/Hold on, wait for a little while.

Hiligaynon: Nagapamanagbanag pa lang sang nagbugtaw ako.
English: It was just dawning when I woke up.

Hiligaynon: Kasanag na sang nag-abot ang balita.
English: It was already daylight when the news arrived.

Hiligaynon: Sa masunod nga bulan, ma-ani na kami sang tubo.
English: Next month, we will be harvesting sugarcane.

Hiligaynon: Handum ko nga mag-abot ka sing temprano.
English: I wish for you to arrive early.

Hiligaynon: Ulihi na ang tanan para mag-hinulsol.
English: Everything is late for repenting.

Hiligaynon: Dugay na kita nga wala nagkitaay.
English: It has been a long time since we saw each other.

Hiligaynon: Hinali lang nag-baskog ang ulan.
English: The rain suddenly became strong.

Hiligaynon: Nagasaka na ang adlaw sa bukid.
English: The sun is rising on the mountain.

Hiligaynon: Talagsa lang sia mag-bisita diri.
English: He seldom visits here.

Hiligaynon: Permi kami nagapangamuyo kon gab-i.
English: We always pray at night.

Hiligaynon: Kaisa lang ako nakakadto sa Negros.
English: I have been to Negros only once.

Hiligaynon: Liwat kita nga mag-istoryahanay sa masunod.
English: We will talk again next time.

Hiligaynon: Madasig ang lakat sang panahon.
English: The pace of time is fast.

Hiligaynon: Mahinay ang pag-tulo sang ulan.
English: The falling of the rain is slow.

Hiligaynon: Tunga-gab-i na sang nag-untat ang huni sang sili-sili.
English: It was midnight when the cicada's sound stopped.

Hiligaynon: Aga pa kami nag-preparar sang pagkaon.
English: We prepared the food early in the morning.

Hiligaynon: Gab-i na sang nag-pauli ang mga manganon.
English: It was already night when the farmers went home.

Hiligaynon: Mag-hulat ka sa sirum.
English: Wait for the dusk/nightfall.

Hiligaynon: Sini nga hapon, may miting sa barangay.
English: This afternoon, there is a meeting in the barangay.

Hiligaynon: Sadto nga tiempo, wala pa sing kuryente diri.
English: In those times, there was no electricity here yet.

Hiligaynon: Sa ulihi, makit-an mo man ang kamatuoran.
English: In the end, you will see the truth.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangidlap ang mga bituon sa kahitaasan.
English: The stars are twinkling in the heights.

Hiligaynon: Mabugnaw ang yamog sa mga dahon.
English: The dew is cool on the leaves.

Hiligaynon: May daku nga balangaw pagkatapos sang ulan.
English: There is a big rainbow after the rain.

Hiligaynon: Nagaguwa ang singat-adlaw sa panganod.
English: The sunbeams are coming out from the clouds.

Hiligaynon: Nagapang-alimunaw ang alipu-pus.
English: The whirlwind/dust devil is swirling.

Hiligaynon: Mabaskog ang unos sa lawod.
English: The squall/storm is strong at sea.

Hiligaynon: Kabay pa nga maayo ang panahon bwas.
English: I hope the weather is good tomorrow.

Hiligaynon: Amat-amat nga nag-pulo ang kasanag.
English: The light gradually faded.

Hiligaynon: Sang una, madamo pa sing kahoy diri.
English: Before/In the past, there were still many trees here.

Hiligaynon: Pila ka adlaw ang imo pagtinir sa Iloilo?
English: How many days is your stay in Iloilo?

Hiligaynon: Nagabaskog ang huyup-huyup sang hangin.
English: The blowing/gust of the wind is getting stronger.

Hiligaynon: Kaluoy sang Dios, wala kami na-abtan sang bagyo.
English: By God's mercy, we weren't reached by the typhoon.

Hiligaynon: Dasig na, kay madulom na ang langit!
English: Hurry, because the sky is already dark!

Hiligaynon: Hinay-hinay lang ang pag-ligad sang mga tinuig.
English: The passing of the years is just slow.

Hiligaynon: Malapit na ang pista sang Pavia.
English: The fiesta of Pavia is near.

Hiligaynon: Malayo pa ang panyaga.
English: Lunch is still far.

Hiligaynon: Bisan san-o, indi ko ikaw malimtan.
English: Whenever/Anytime, I will not forget you.

Hiligaynon: San-o ka mabalik diri sa amon?
English: When will you return here to us?

Hiligaynon: Karon nga gab-i, mapahuway kita sing maayo.
English: Later/Tonight, we will rest well.

Hiligaynon: Antes mag-abot ang ulan, himosa ang mga uga.
English: Before the rain arrives, put away the dried fish.

Hiligaynon: Despues sang panyapon, mag-istorya kita.
English: After dinner, let's talk.

Hiligaynon: Tungod sa init, nagatigas ang duta.
English: Because of the heat, the soil is hardening.

Hiligaynon: Maskin gab-i na, naga-obra pa ang panday.
English: Even if it's already night, the carpenter is still working.

Hiligaynon: Kutob subong, wala pa sia sing balita.
English: Until now, he still has no news.

Hiligaynon: Sa pihak sang bagyo, nag-tindog gihapon ang amon payag.
English: Despite the typhoon, our hut still stood.

Hiligaynon: Dungan sila nga nag-abot kaina.
English: They arrived simultaneously/together earlier.

Hiligaynon: Sa tagsa ka aga, nagainom ako sang kape.
English: Every morning, I drink coffee.

Hiligaynon: Pila ka beses ka nagasimba sa isa ka semana?
English: How many times do you go to church in a week?

Hiligaynon: Masunod nga Sabado, makadto kami sa baybay.
English: Next Saturday, we are going to the beach.

Hiligaynon: Karon gid lang nag-untat ang ulan.
English: The rain stopped just now.

Hiligaynon: Sadto pa ina nga plano.
English: That plan has been around since then.

Hiligaynon: Maka-pila na ako nagbalik-balik diri.
English: I have been back and forth here several times.

Hiligaynon: Halin sang bata pa ako, ari na ako sa Pavia.
English: Since I was a child, I have been here in Pavia.

Hiligaynon: Tubtob san-o ka mag-hulat sa iya?
English: Until when will you wait for him/her?

Hiligaynon: Samtang naga-ulan, mag-tinir lang kita sa sulod.
English: While it's raining, let's just stay inside.

Hiligaynon: Sige-sige ang lakat sang orasan.
English: The clock's movement is continuous.

Hiligaynon: Maathag na ang kalangitan pagkatapos sang unos.
English: The heavens are clear now after the storm.

Hiligaynon: Mapula ang langit sa nakatundan, basi ma-init bwas.
English: The sky is red in the west, maybe it'll be hot tomorrow.

Hiligaynon: Madulom ang bulan sining gab-i.
English: The moon is dark/dim tonight.

Hiligaynon: Mabugnaw ang panahon sa Disyembre.
English: The weather is cool in December.

Hiligaynon: Mainit ang singot sang tawo sa talamnan.
English: The person's sweat is hot in the plantation.

Hiligaynon: Mabunok ang ulan kaina sang kaagahon.
English: The rain was heavy/pouring earlier this morning.

Hiligaynon: Tali-tali lang ang ulan subong.
English: The rain is just drizzling now.

Hiligaynon: Madag-um ang kalangitan sa pihak sang bukid.
English: The heavens are cloudy on the other side of the mountain.

Hiligaynon: Mabaskog ang huyup sang hangin sa baybayon.
English: The blow of the wind is strong at the seashore.

Hiligaynon: Malinong ang dagat sining hapon.
English: The sea is calm this afternoon.

Hiligaynon: Matunod na ang adlaw sa likod sang mga kahoy.
English: The sun is about to set behind the trees.

Hiligaynon: Masilak ang adlaw subong nga Martes.
English: The sun is sunny/bright this Tuesday.

Hiligaynon: Mahulas ang pamatasan sang panahon.
English: The weather's "behavior" is humid/sultry.

Hiligaynon: Mabug-at ang gal-um sa kahanginan.
English: The clouds in the air are heavy.

Hiligaynon: Maayo ang lakat sang tyempo subong.
English: The flow of the weather is good now.

Hiligaynon: Sa diutay lang nga tinion, matapos na ini.
English: In just a little time, this will be finished.

Hiligaynon: Wala sing katapusan ang pagligad sang tinion.
English: The passing of time has no end.

Hiligaynon: Salamat sa Ginuo sa sining matahum nga adlaw.
English: Thank you to the Lord for this beautiful day.

Hiligaynon: Kabay pa nga mangin maayo ang aton bwas.
English: I hope our tomorrow will be good.

Hiligaynon: Amo gid ina ang lakat sang kabuhi kag panahon.
English: That is exactly the flow of life and time.

Hiligaynon: Palangga ko gid ang akon mga ginikanan.
English: I really love my parents.

Hiligaynon: Sia ang akon kamagulangan nga utod.
English: He/she is my eldest sibling.

Hiligaynon: Naga-inupdanay ang mga mag-utod sa obra.
English: The siblings are helping each other at work.

Hiligaynon: Malapit ang amon balay sa akon tito.
English: Our house is near my uncle.

Hiligaynon: Maayo gid magluto ang akon tiya.
English: My aunt cooks very well.

Hiligaynon: Sin-o ang imo pinalangga sa kabuhi?
English: Who is your beloved in life?

Hiligaynon: Nagabisita kami sa amon lolo kag lola.
English: We are visiting our grandfather and grandmother.

Hiligaynon: Madamo ako sing panyabon (paryente) sa Pavia.
English: I have many relatives in Pavia.

Hiligaynon: Maabtik ang akon hinablos sa eskwelahan.
English: My nephew/niece is smart in school.

Hiligaynon: Sia ang akon panganay nga bata.
English: He/she is my first-born child.

Hiligaynon: Ang amon mago (kamagulangan) amo ang nagatuytoy sa amon.
English: Our eldest is the one guiding us.

Hiligaynon: Pila kamo ka mag-ulutod sa pamilya?
English: How many siblings are you in the family?

Hiligaynon: Maayo ang amon relasyon sa amon bilas.
English: Our relationship with our brother/sister-in-law's spouse is good.

Hiligaynon: Nagabulig ang akon hipag sa pag-atipan sang bata.
English: My sister-in-law helps in taking care of the child.

Hiligaynon: Malapit ang buot ko sa akon bayaw.
English: I am close with my brother-in-law.

Hiligaynon: Nagatindog sia bilang maninoy sa bunyag.
English: He stands as a godfather in the baptism.

Hiligaynon: Sia ang akon paborito nga maninay.
English: She is my favorite godmother.

Hiligaynon: Ang amon ihado mapisan nga bata.
English: Our godson is an industrious child.

Hiligaynon: Nagaduaw ang akon ihada kada pista.
English: My goddaughter visits every fiesta.

Hiligaynon: Kinahanglan naton amligan ang aton dungog.
English: We need to protect our honor/reputation.

Hiligaynon: Ang garbo sang pamilya amo ang maayo nga pamatasan.
English: The pride of the family is good behavior.

Hiligaynon: Mag-ulikid ka sa imo ginhalinan.
English: Look back/care for your origins/roots.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang laygay sa mga malatiko.
English: We are asking for advice from the elders.

Hiligaynon: Ang aton kaingod mabinuligon gid.
English: Our neighbor is very helpful.

Hiligaynon: Maayo ang amon pag-inupdanay sa barangay.
English: Our companionship/living together in the barangay is good.

Hiligaynon: Sin-o ang imo abyan sa syudad?
English: Who is your friend in the city?

Hiligaynon: Nagapakig-abyan kita sa tanan nga tawo.
English: We are making friends with all people.

Hiligaynon: Ang barkada ni Juan mabuot man.
English: Juan's circle of friends is also good.

Hiligaynon: Mag-respeto kita sa aton isigkatawo.
English: Let us respect our fellowman.

Hiligaynon: Nag-entra sia sa pagpangasawa kaina.
English: He entered into the formal courtship/asking for marriage earlier.

Hiligaynon: Madinalag-on ang ila kasal sa katedral.
English: Their wedding at the cathedral was successful.

Hiligaynon: Nagaselebrar kami sang anibersaryo sang amon kasal.
English: We are celebrating our wedding anniversary.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagsalig amo ang pundasyon sang pamilya.
English: Trust is the foundation of the family.

Hiligaynon: Indi mag-pakamalaut sang imo kabanay.
English: Do not speak ill/curse of your kin.

Hiligaynon: Nagahiusa ang komunidad sa pagpanglimpyo.
English: The community is uniting in cleaning up.

Hiligaynon: Sia ang amon pakaisa sa Negros.
English: He/she is our cousin in Negros.

Hiligaynon: Nagapamuhi ang mga himata para sa lubong.
English: The kinsfolk are gathering for the funeral.

Hiligaynon: Mabug-at ang amon kalisod sa pagtaliwan sang amon pinalangga.
English: Our sorrow is heavy at the passing of our beloved.

Hiligaynon: I-pa-misa naton ang aton namatay nga kaparyentehan.
English: Let’s have a Mass offered for our deceased relatives.

Hiligaynon: Nagapadayon ang aton pag-unong sa pamilya.
English: Our loyalty/staying together in the family continues.

Hiligaynon: Ang pagkamadinugunon tanda sang matuod nga Ilonggo.
English: Kindness/Warmth is a sign of a true Ilonggo.

Hiligaynon: Mag-puyo kita sing malinong upod sa aton kaingod.
English: Let us live peacefully with our neighbors.

Hiligaynon: Ang pag-ulikid sa tigulang isa ka bugay.
English: Caring/Looking after the elderly is a blessing.

Hiligaynon: Nagapangayo kami sang bendisyon sa amon lola.
English: We are asking for a blessing from our grandmother.

Hiligaynon: Ang pag-inupdanay sa balay manami gid.
English: Living together at home is very good.
